reviews.t: Wake up to the sound of a clean, close shave.
reviews.x: I was shopping for replacement cutters and combs for a Norelco Micro Action (formerly Lift & Cut [formerly Rotatract]) shaver and noticed that for less than $10 more I could have a whole new  Norelco shaver. I was sold.  Norelco Reflex Plus shavers combine 4 features pioneered by Norelco and improved over time. Rotary heads reduce the vibration common to reciprocating shavers. Floating heads individually hug the skin. Lift and Cut blades gently pull whiskers into the cutter for a closer shave. E

The 6423LC shaves closer than my 10-year-old Norelco/Philishave, (also corded -- I find the cordless models have insufficient power) even when both have brand-new heads.  And it irritates my skin less, except when my beard is several days long: the 6423LC lacks an adjustable closeness setting that would let you set it less close to avoid irritating your skin too much on those days.  But for those of you who shave every day or two this is a good choice.

The first thing I noticed about this shaver is that it weighs half of the 10 year old rechargable Norelco 300SX it replaced, due to it not having batteries inside. Also, this shaver is much quieter and is less irritating to my sensitive skin than the old shaver.

My previous corded shaver was a 10-year-old basic Norelco on which I'd replaced the cutting heads probably three times.  It served me well until it bit the dust.  I wouldn't have anything but a Norelco so I got this one from Amazon at a great price.  I didn't think it could shave better than the old model, but it really, really does.  I can't see the added cost of getting a rechargable model.  Corded works for me (and I suppose the vast majority of people.) I highly recommend this Norelco shaver

I've used Norelcos for over 30 years. This latest version comes from China, with questionable implications as to quality and conditions of manufacture.   Extremely light and quiet, it feels more like a woman's shaver. Therefore, it may not be suitable for men with heavy beards who are not accustomed to electric razors.   Older Norelcos were solid, well made and came with solid cases; this model has no case at all, making careful handling essential. Considering this shaver's apparent fragility, i

Well!  This unit replaced a perhaps 8 or 10 year old Norelco razor that I hadn't changed the blades on ever.  Compared to my old Norelco, this one is much much quieter.  It's almost silent.  The heads can pivot, as well as be "pushed in".  After the second shave, I found that the shave was very smooth, and the shaver is so flexible in it's "floating heads" design that I barely felt as if I was shaving hair at all.  There's nothing shoddy or yesterday about this razor...I will use this candy blue

Delivers basically what it promises - shaves a face (some razors don't deliver on their promises).  Good points:  [1] good price;  [2] no battery to have to keep charging.  Bad points:  [1] slow - I anticipated faster-revolving cutters, but it gets there if you keep at it;  [2] not a very close shave, but then (from previous experience) I didn't expect it from this Norelco design.

I have been a Norelco Electric Razor user for about fifteen years. In fact this new one just replaced my original. When I first received it one month ago I was immediatly skeptical because it said Made in China. My original norelco was made in Holland as was all Norelcos. After using it every day for a month,needless to say, I won't need to pull my old one back out. I'm impressed with how comfortable and easily it takes off my whiskers. The floating head is truly a floating head,not just the bla

(1) Short,coiled cord is a a pain. Threw it out and used the long staright cord from my old Norelco.  (2) Fine shave if you aren't going out in public. It gets the easy parts, but below th chin I might just as well not have shaved. Thank God I'm retired. This wouldn't do if I had to make a business call.

I have been using the 6423LC shaver only a couple of weeks.  When I began using it, I noticed that it made less noise than my old older Norelco corded shaver (3405LC ?).  That concerned me because I wondered if the newer one would shave as well.  It does! I had my older one for more than eight years, and it was still giving me good shaves until I discarded it.  Simply replacing the circular cutters was another option, but for a few dollars more I decided to buy the current model.  I do not shave

I own this shaver and am currently in the market for a new one.  I was very surprised to see the overwhelming # of positive reviews for this product.  This shaver has been a disappointment since day 1.  It pulls hair and does not offer a smooth comfortable shave like more expensive models.  Save your $30 and invest it in a nicer shaver.  Pros:  Price  Cons:  Corded  Flimsy hinge  Pulls hair  Uncomfortable on neck area  Shave not smooth

I have been a norelco customer for many years.  I have always shaved with a straight razor and then with an electric after that.  Once I purchased this razor I found that this one gives me such a clean close shave that I am able to use the electric alone.  I am so glad that I purchased this razor and I can highly recommend the product and say that anyone that purchases this item will not be sorry.

I've been using Norelco shavers for years.  This basic model gives me as good a shave as any of them (and certainly a better one than other brands that I've used).  Some people might mistake the quiet running motor for a slow running one, but that doesn't seem to be the case.  I've been getting fast, close, comfortable shaves without worringing that a rechargeable battery will run out or eventually lose its ability to hold a charge.  Considering how high the price of razor blades has gotten this

I purchased the Norelco base on the average of the reviews. They must have been written by people from Norelco. This shaver (I shouldn't use the word shaver) is like a wind up toy. My stubble almost stopped the rotary blades. What a piece of garbage. I STONGLY do not recomend this product. Do yourself a favor and get a Remington foil shaver.

Guess I should have paid more attention to the negative reviews.  I was hoping, since it is a corded model, that it would have a powerfull motor.  I have a older Remington rechargable (which is broken which is why I ordered this) that is faster.  So far, with new blades, it is shaving pretty good.  I have not experienced any "lift and pull".  Will be interesting to see how it is after the blades dull a bit.  Could use a longer cord as well.  Still, for $34.00 and free shipping it isn't a bad buy

I had a Norelco shaver with batteries in the '80 that worked very good and when traving it did its job. Now I do not need a battery power shaver and so I ordered this unit. I do not know where the motor came from but it is so under powered that it can not do the job. The best place for this unit maybe that it can be used on a fishing line.  MG
Used for exactly 3 weeks, but from day one it was pulling skin. and till the last day it was doing same stuff. Had to return after three weeks

My beefs with my old cordless shavers have always been the weight and the lack of power, especially when the batteries are low.  This is a lightweight and powerful shaver at an excellent price!  Plus, cmon, how many times in your life have you really needed to shave without an electrical outlet within reach?

reviews.t: Lift and rip out your hair.
reviews.x: Their "lift and cut" system is more like "lift and rip out your hair" system.  This thing was just plain painful to use, right out of the box.  It's also very slow an under powered.  I've had rechargable shavers that were much more powerful.

Just used this razor for the first time.  Could not get a close shave out of it at all.  The trimmer will cut hair but not stubble.  On top of all of this it gave me a pretty bad gash.  I'm very disappointed in this razor but I guess I got what I paid for.  I'm going to order a new razor right now because I can't stand to shave with this one any longer than necessary.
I bought this razor as a father's day gift for my father, and he told me that he absolutely loves this product.  He said it  shaves very well and it's perfect.
A hunk of junk. Lasted less than a week.I never had a shaver last less than two years.Last norelco I would buy.

I've used this for over a year now, so it seems fair to review it.  It does not shave as close as a blade, but no one expects it to. It does not seem as fast on multiday growth as the non-rotary shaver I used 40 years ago, but it seems as fast when used daily. (Memories of 40 years ago are not reliable.)  It does a good job of keeping the waste inside. Instead of the recommended cleaning every two weeks, I just remove the head every weekend and tap the head and body against the sink a few times.

This is the first time I had tried a electric shaver!  And trust me stick with your old mach 3 ! I can now see a crop of pimples and a irreguar shaved small beard as a token from my first time use!  And that, in this winter, when my skin dried up makes it look even worse!

Norelco makes the best electric shaver.Although this particular one is not cordless, it is dual voltage. You can use it any where in the world. It is less than half of the price of the cordless one by Norelco.

claims.text: Many reviewers find this shaver delivers a close, clean shave and consider it a good value for the price.
Several reviewers note the shaver is much quieter and lighter than their older Norelco models.
Some reviewers report the shaver is underpowered or slow, with weak cutting performance.
A few reviewers mention skin irritation or an incomplete shave, especially on longer beards or the neck area.
Some reviewers express concern about the Made in China manufacturing and perceived lower build quality.
